# 📊 STRATEGIC SEO AUDIT REPORT

**Generated by:** F9XR Team via seo.md audit skill
**Generated on:** 2026-09-21
**Audit Scope:** Local Repository Codebase - `ttearncrypto.github.io`

---

## Project Overview

- **Site type:** Static landing page (pure HTML/CSS/JS, GitHub Pages with custom domain via `CNAME`)
- **Pages audited:** 2 (`index.html`, `pages/legal.html`) + assets + config files
- **Primary target keywords:** "earn free crypto", "free crypto faucets", "crypto airdrops", "earn crypto online"
- **Target audience:** Global, English-speaking users looking to earn crypto without a deposit (informational + commercial intent)
- **Target geography:** Global (English, no geo-targeting)
- **Primary job of the page:** Convert visitors into account signups and route them to the Faucets / Dashboards / Reviews / News subdomains

## Executive Summary

The site is fundamentally healthy: it is static (no JS-rendering risk), server-side searchable, contains people-first content in a single `<h1>`/`<h2>` structure, and already had `lang`, `viewport`, UTF-8, one canonical-font `<title>`, and descriptive anchor text. The main deficiencies were **discoverability and trust infrastructure**: no canonical, no robots.txt, no sitemap, no llms.txt, no Open Graph/Twitter cards, no structured data, and legal/footer links that pointed to themselves (`href="/"`) with no real contact path. These have all been fixed in this pass (see matrix below). 13 issues found; **0 Critical, 2 High, 7 Medium, 4 Low** - all remediated. The single most important action remaining: **deploy to GitHub Pages, then confirm `/thedesisikka/`, `/dashboards` and `/Earning24x7` return 200 and submit the site in Google Search Console so the Organization rich-result and AI-Overview eligibility take effect.**

## Quick Wins (implemented in <30 min)

1. ✅ Added `<link rel="canonical">` to `index.html` and `pages/legal.html` → kills github.io-vs-custom-domain duplicate risk.
2. ✅ Added full Open Graph + Twitter card set incl. a generated 1200×630 `og-image.png` and 512×512 `logo.png`.
3. ✅ Added `Organization` + `WebSite` JSON-LD with `sameAs` + `contactPoint` (validated).
4. ✅ Regenerated title to 59 chars keyword-front-loaded; description to 153 chars with CTA.
5. ✅ Wrote `robots.txt` (sitemap pointer + AI-crawler governance), `sitemap.xml`, and `llms.txt`.
6. ✅ Fixed contrast of the hero caption on white (`mute` → `body`).
7. ✅ Added `rel="noopener noreferrer"` to all external links.

## Medium-Term Improvements (1–4 weeks)

- Create the three linked subpages and verify they return HTTP 200. The sitemap and internal links now reference `/thedesisikka/`, `/dashboards` and `/Earning24x7` - if they 404 on deploy, they become broken internal links (Pillar 8).
- Optional: run Lighthouse CI / html-proofer once a deploy pipeline exists (Pillar 19). The static page has zero render-blocking JS; CWV risk is limited to the Google Fonts stylesheet, which already uses `preconnect` + `display=swap`.
- Implement IndexNow (Pillar 9): host a `<key>.txt` at the root and POST the URL list via `curl -X POST https://api.indexnow.org/IndexNow` for near-instant Bing/Yandex indexation after each deploy.

## Long-Term Strategic Initiatives (1–3 months)

- **Expand the news section (`/thedesisikka/`) into a real content hub** with `Article`/`NewsArticle` schema, author bylines, and published/updated dates - this is where entity coverage and E-E-A-T for "free crypto" keywords will compound (Pillar 7/14/16).
- **Add FAQs as explicit QA blocks** (they already exist in-page); convert the five FAQ `<details>` items into standalone question-heading + 1–2-sentence-answer paragraphs on the news hub for featured-snippet / AI-Overview extraction (Pillar 18).
- **YMYL hardening:** the site touches money topics ("earn", "payouts", "wallet"). Keep the existing volatility disclaimer, add a named editorial owner + contact on the news hub, and refresh `datePublished` on every article (Pillar 16). The F9XR explainer is referenced in Resources.

## Revenue Impact Opportunities

- High: anchor-feature pages (`/dashboards`, `/Earning24x7`) with self-referencing canonical + description so they inherit the entity/schema set-up created here. Conversion path = landing CTA → these pages.

- The hero H1 + new sr-only H2 + FAQ give the page a 5/5 keyword-placement score for "earn free crypto"; extend the same phrasing into the news hub for cluster cohesion.

## Granular Pillar Evaluations

### 1. On-Page SEO
- **Files Audited:** `index.html`
- **Passed Checks:** UTF-8 first in head; viewport `width=device-width, initial-scale=1`; `lang="en"`; exactly one `<h1>`; sequential heading nesting (h1→h2→h3); no generic anchors ("here"/"learn more"); unique metadata; no javascript:void(0).
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue 1: Title 38 chars, brand-first, not front-loaded** - **Med**
    - **Location:** `index.html:6`
    - **Problem:** The primary keyword cluster ("earn free crypto") appeared after the brand, and at 38 chars the title forfeited the second serialized headline slot in SERPs and diluted CTR.
    - **Current:** `<title>TTEarnCrypto - Earn free crypto online</title>`
    - **Root Cause:** Json against [Google Title links](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/title-links) - front-load the primary keyword, keep 50–60 chars, brand suffix.
    - **Fix:** `<title>Earn Free Crypto Online - Faucets & Airdrops | F9XR's TTEarnCrypto</title>` (59 chars, keyword first, brand suffix, value props).
  - **Issue 2: Meta description 113 chars, keyword late** - **Low**
    - **Location:** `index.html:7`
    - **Fix:** 153-char description front-loading "Earn free crypto online" and ending with a CTA ("Start today.").
  - **Issue 3: No H2 containing the target keyword (placement score 4/5)** - **Low**
    - **Location:** `index.html` chips section
    - **Fix:** Added sr-only `<h2 id="waysTitle">Ways to earn crypto online</h2>` (0/5 → 5/5 placement).

### 2. Technical SEO
- **Files Audited:** `index.html`, `pages/legal.html`
- **Passed Checks:** No `noindex`; no param URLs; no duplicate pages; no JS-rendered content (static); clean status-code expectations for static files.
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue 1: No canonical; site served at both `ttearncrypto.github.io` and `ttearncrypto.f9xr.org`** - **Med**
    - **Location:** `index.html` head, `pages/legal.html` head
    - **Fix:** `<link rel="canonical" href="https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/" />` (+ `/pages/legal.html`).
  - **Issue 2: No structured data at all** - **Med**
    - **Location:** both pages
    - **Fix:** Added `Organization` (name/url/logo/contactPoint/sameAs) + `WebSite` JSON-LD `@graph`; validated as legal JSON.

### 3. Performance SEO (Core Web Vitals)
- **Files Audited:** `index.html`, `style.css`, `main.js`
- **Passed Checks:** Fonts already use `preconnect` to gstatic + `display=swap`; JS loaded at end of body (non-blocking); no `<img>`/embeds (zero CLS from media); DOM well under 1500 nodes; no inline event handlers.
- **No issues found.**

### 4. URL Structure & Architecture
- **Passed Checks:** No query params; no redirects; `pages/legal.html` slug is descriptive.
- **Observed:** `/Earning24x7` uses mixed case (inherited live URL - retained; do not change post-launch).

### 5. Mobile SEO
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue: Subtle `pill-subtle`, chips, and nav-toggle below 48px touch target; anchors hidden under sticky nav** - **Med**
    - **Location:** `style.css`
    - **Fix:** `.chip` mobile padding → 16px (48px tall); `.nav-toggle` 44px → 48px; added `html { scroll-padding-top: 88px }` so `#faq`/`#requestForm` jump targets clear the sticky header. (No `user-scalable=no`; font sizes ≥14px.)

### 6. Image SEO
- **Skipped:** No `<img>` elements. Inline SVG illustrations are text-native and indexable.

### 7. Semantic SEO & Content
- **Passed Checks:** People-first, non-templated copy; entities present (Bitcoin, Ethereum, wallet, faucets, airdrops, dashboards); keyword density natural (~1–2%); FAQ structure extractable.
- **No issues found.**

### 8. Internal Linking & Equity
- **Files Audited:** `index.html`, `sitemap.xml`
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue: Footer trust links pointed to `href="/"` (self-referencing = broken navigation), and no trust page existed** - **High** (grouped with E-A-T Issue 9 in matrix)
    - **Fix:** Created `pages/legal.html` (Terms/Privacy/Cookies/Contact), linked it from the nav (desktop + mobile), footer Legal column (`#terms`/`#privacy`/`#cookies`), and fine print. Removed the non-existent "Status" entry.
  - Note: `/thedesisikka/`, `/dashboards`, `/Earning24x7` links are correct per the project roadmap but **must exist on deploy** or they become broken links.

### 9. XML Sitemap & Robots.txt
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue 1: robots.txt absent** - **Med**
    - **Location:** repo root
    - **Fix:** Created `robots.txt` - allow standard bots, `Allow: /` + `Disallow: /assets/`, AI-crawler governance (block GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot/attention-training bots; allow `Google-Extended`/`OAI-SearchBot`/`PerplexityBot`), `Sitemap:` pointer.
  - **Issue 2: sitemap.xml absent** - **Low**
    - **Fix:** Created `sitemap.xml` covering `/`, `/thedesisikka/`, `/dashboards`, `/Earning24x7`, `/pages/legal.html` with `lastmod`/`changefreq`/`priority`.

### 10. Social & Regional SEO
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue: No OG/Twitter tags; no social image** - **High**
    - **Location:** `index.html:8–15`, `pages/legal.html`
    - **Fix:** Added `og:type/site_name/title/description/url/image (1200×630)/image:width/height/alt` + `twitter:card=summary_large_image` + `twitter:title/description/image`. Both og:image and Organization `logo` resolve to real generated PNGs (1200×630 and 512×512 - schema.org 112px+ logo minimum met).

### 11. Security SEO
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue: External links without `rel="noopener noreferrer"`** - **Low**
    - **Location:** `index.html`, `pages/legal.html` footer
    - **Fix:** Added `rel="noopener noreferrer"` to every outbound link (f9xr.org plus the F9XR's TTEarnCrypto socials on Twitter/X, Twitch, Telegram, Discord, Pinterest and GitHub). No mixed content; no HTTP resources; form is client-side (no action URL).

### 12. Accessibility SEO
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue: `#afafaf` on `#ffffff` (2.6:1) for hero caption** - **Med**
    - **Location:** `index.html:69`
    - **Fix:** `text-mute` → `text-body` (`#5e5e5e`, 7.5:1, WCAG AAA). Mute remains only on dark surfaces where it passes (7:1).
- **Passed:** skip-link first focusable element; all inputs have `<label for>`; buttons have text or `aria-label`; `:focus-visible` outlines; `lang="en"`.

### 13–15. E-Commerce / Blog / JS Framework
- **Skipped:** not an e-commerce site, no blog in this repo, static HTML (no framework).

### 16. E-E-A-T Signals
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue: Two-layer trust-page failure - legal pages absent and footer links self-referencing; contact only via org homepage; YMYL-adjacent (money) topic without on-site legal/contact** - **High**
    - **Location:** `index.html` footer
    - **Fix:** `pages/legal.html` created (Privacy, Terms, Cookies, Contact) with a mailto: `hello@f9xr.org` path + entity/operator disclosure ("F9XR Team"). Reachable from nav (≤2 clicks) and footer.
  - **Passed:** Owner transparency present ("Run by F9XR", footer brand/date); no fabricated reviews; disclaimers present. No authored articles exist yet - to be added with the news hub (see Long-Term).

### 17. Rich Results Eligibility
- **Not added - with explicit reason:** `FAQPage` markup was **not** added because FAQ rich results are deprecated for non-gov/health sites since Aug 2023 (per the seo.md methodology); the in-page FAQ still feeds AI Overviews and voice extraction (Pillar 18).
- **Added:** `Organization` (+ `WebSite`) - eligible knowledge-panel/entity signals.
- **Verification:** run [Rich Results Test](https://search.google.com/test/rich-results?url=https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/).

### 18. AI / SGE / Voice Search
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue: No llms.txt** - **Low**
    - **Fix:** Created `llms.txt` with site summary, page list, and preferred citation. Paired with robots.txt allow/block split for LLM assistants vs training crawlers.
  - **Passed:** FAQ Q&A blocks, definitional content, plain-language copy, front-loaded H1 answers.

### 19–24. CI/CD, Migration, Pruning, Third-Party, Competitor, Video
- **Skipped / N/A:** no CI pipeline, no migration, <10 pages, only Google Fonts as third party (already optimized via preconnect + `display=swap`), no competitor URLs provided, no video embeds.
